messages:
eli: quick note from the QA sweep — the sparklines in the routes table vanish at 50% zoom on Chrome with the midnight palette. tiny stroke width + low saturation seems to be the combo. noticed on both macOS and Windows.

maya: ugh, saw that too. those sparklines are 1px hairlines currently. can we try 1.5px for medium density rows and use semi-opaque white overlay for focus? would keep density but help scan.

simon: for color strategy, option A: boost the primary sparkline luminance by +8% and keep saturation; option B: keep luminance but switch to slightly warmer tint so it reads on the gradient. prefer A because it preserves semantic hue system.

eli: +1 to A. also request: add a non-color affordance for flagged routes (tiny diamond marker at the end of the sparkline) so colorblind users can still spot them.

product-ally: copy nit from the top-left filter: "Active routes" -> "Active routes (filtered)" caused confusion in the beta. small change but product wants it explicit.

maya: i'll update mock. also found an odd touch: tooltip backgrounds on hover are using `token.panel.elevated` which is slightly warmer, causing an orange fringe with amber series lines. suggest tooltip bg use `token.panel.surface` for neutral.

simon: agree. and for the sparkline marker shape: diamond is good, but need accessibility name / aria label for screen readers. design-bot, can you add that to the component spec?

design-bot: added `sparkline.marker.shape = diamond`, `sparkline.marker.aria = "flagged route"` to /components/charts spec. pushed frame: /design/sparkline-accessibility-v1.

eli: a11y-bot, can you run contrast on the adjusted primary sparkline (+8% lum) vs table bg and also the tooltip bg swap?

a11y-bot: running checks...
- sparkline primary (adjusted) vs table bg: 5.4:1 ✅
- tooltip bg (`token.panel.surface`) vs tooltip text: 7.2:1 ✅
- diamond marker fill vs table bg (8px marker): 3.9:1 ⚠️ (below 4.5 for small elements)
Recommendation: increase diamond to 10px or add 1px stroke around it (stroke color `#0b0d0f @ 56%`) to hit threshold.

maya: prefer increasing marker size to 10px, keeps stroke simpler. will update figma.

product-ally: small copy follow-up: filter label change looks good. can we also make the table column header read "Avg. latency (ms)" instead of "Latency"? teams were misinterpreting units.

eli: yes change that too. while we're at it, let's add a tiny tooltip to the header that says "avg: p50 across selected interval" — product asked for that micro-copy.

simon: one more nit: disabled row states (when route has no data) use 40% opacity on tokens which currently yields low contrast on mobile: small text drops below 3:1. propose using 56% opacity instead for disabled text and keeping icons at 40% to maintain visual hierarchy.

a11y-bot: check for disabled text at 56% vs table bg: 3.0:1 ⚠️ — still low for small text. Note: disabled text doesn't need 4.5:1 but should be >3:1 for legibility. 56% hits ~3.0:1, ok if we treat it as non-primary. Recommend also increasing font-size 0.5px on mobile for disabled rows.

maya: ok i'll tweak opacity to 60% and we can test mobile font adjustment in staging.

design-bot: token PR created: tokens/sparkline-midnight-v2.json with primary sparkline +8% lum, tooltip bg swap, diamond=10px, disabled.opacity=60%.

eli: final test request: please run the heavy-data table with 200 rows on staging to ensure perf and visual rhythm. i saw slight jitter when hovering many rows. maya, simon — can you QA tomorrow morning?

maya: will do, i'll also attach before/after screenshots and a short screen recording for QA.

simon: will review token PR and double-check color variable comments to explain the diamond size reasoning for a11y.

eli: lovely. thank you all — if a11y-bot clears the diamond contrast and staging perf looks good, design-bot can merge the token PR. :white_check_mark:

(attachments: figma_sparkline_v2.png, recording_hover_jitter.mp4, token-pr-512.diff)
